title: How to Sleep After BBL?
meta_description: How to Sleep After BBL? Discover safe sleep positions, accessories, and recovery tips to protect your results.
excerpt: Recovering properly after your Brazilian Butt Lift requires careful attention to your sleeping position. How to sleep after BBL is a critical factor in ensuring optimal results, as you'll need to sleep on your stomach or your side, and stay off your back until your surgeon clears it.
quick_answer:
How do you sleep after a BBL?

On your stomach or your side, as Cleveland Clinic advises, and off your back until your surgeon clears it. The Aesthetic Society says to avoid direct pressure on your buttocks for at least 8 weeks. The same holds after a BBL with lipo 360, and pillows can help you stay in position.
